source_pr.title: Consolidate Pages beta security, privacy, and recovery
source_pr.body:
## Why

The Pages beta work is spread across overlapping security, recovery, hosting, and dependency branches. This draft brings the reviewed changes into one candidate so the combined source can be qualified and reviewed together.

## Changes

- Integrate private checkpoint scoping, explicit balance-request consent, safer privacy defaults, and session cancellation/clock protections.
- Integrate Spec 18 portable key export and recovery, including import consent/cancellation binding and visible recovery/export disclosures.
- Consolidate selected Pages frame/origin protections, manifest and bundle checks, artifact provenance, and manual deployment gates.
- Keep root error reporting limited to fixed labels and make the Pages smoke test fail on those render-error reports without copying console payloads.
- Integrate the reviewed dependency alignment and security-tooling corrections.
- Wipe temporary legacy-keystore passphrase buffers on success and failure without changing the format or KDF.

## Qualification status

**Draft: combined-candidate qualification is still running, and fresh hosted results for this published head are pending.** Source-pinned focused evidence and remaining limits are recorded in the [recovery handoff](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/GhostPay/blob/9bad95e5cc0ee73f5adb8d2c587161074b21e080/docs/handoffs/agents/PAGES_RECOVERY_INTEGRATION_20261118.md) and [Pages smoke review](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/GhostPay/blob/9bad95e5cc0ee73f5adb8d2c587161074b21e080/docs/handoffs/agents/PAGES_SMOKE_RENDER_ERRORS_20261118.md). The coordinator will append the final combined-source qualification report.

This PR is for review and CI. It does not authorize a deployment, release, mainnet enablement, or merge to main. The existing release-test requirements remain in place; the unrelated release-test relaxation from PR #209 was excluded. Do not merge until the exact published candidate passes its required gates and independent review is complete.

## Source provenance

Shell Git publication had no CLI credential, so the authenticated GitHub Git Data API was used to preserve the unpublished local topology:

| Source | Identifier |
| --- | --- |
| Main observed before publication | `dfc75ef2087fa6463ae59e0818abec01796c578d` |
| Original local candidate | `e8c77e7e8699dd16b86b7a1ff90b834594d07105` |
| Published candidate | `9bad95e5cc0ee73f5adb8d2c587161074b21e080` |
| Identical source tree | `81341de7972041b5f7ce53da76027846356fab90` |

All 61 recreated local commits retain their original tree hashes and ordered parent relationships, including 15 merge commits. Existing remote commit identities are unchanged. Because the connector cannot set author/date fields, each recreated commit explicitly records its original local SHA, author and author date, committer and committer date, and original parent SHAs in provenance trailers. Every created tree and commit was read back and checked before the branch was created. No existing branch was rewritten.
